== House Haevin banner ==

A quick check of the books and the Companion shows the background isn't specified. In the scenes with [[Catalyn Haevin]], however, the girl wears clothing that is green, blue and red at different times with the red being the last mentioned. Since it's obvious the background has to be some colour, it seems reasonable to pick what looks best in terms of contrast from the above choices. [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 12:39, 16 November 2020 (UTC)
